answer: The grading quorum of 6 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The echo assignment is published and crystal records each panel. Shards are assigned from the canyon graph, so that cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 704 identities would post 2821 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
